# noqeri/csv 0.5.0

Document-level RFC-style quote-state scanning including embedded newlines, plus formula-injection risk classification.

In addition to these functions, the full MIT 0.1.1 API is preserved. This version is experimental until the new regression cases and compatibility are executed on the native Noqeri SDK. The package identifies CSV formula risks but does not automatically neutralize data or implement every regional CSV dialect.

See `src/csv.noqeri`, `tests/regression.noqeri`, and `tests/depth_regression.noqeri`.
